en: Vintage divided‑back postcard printed in Hungarian. The front shows a monochrome pencil drawing of a long Baroque/Classicist civic building along a gently rising street lined with trees. A lone figure stands on the sidewalk and a small guardhouse or sentry box is visible near the entrance. The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines, a boxed area for a stamp, and printed Hungarian captions indicating the subject and the publisher.
